name: cr603_7_sneak_attack_haste_and_end_step_sacrifice
why: Sneak Attack (ChangeZone RememberChanged$ hand to battlefield, then DB$ Animate Defined$ Remembered | Keywords$ Haste | Duration$ Permanent | AtEOT$ Sacrifice): the creature it puts onto the battlefield gains haste (CR 702.10) and is sacrificed by a delayed trigger at the beginning of the next end step (CR 603.7). Animate read neither Defined$ Remembered, Keywords$ nor AtEOT$ (AtEOT$ was taken by the token parser), so the creature could not attack and stayed (found by the first onboarding's scripted games, show_and_tell); the Animate resolves before the creature's Permanent is built, so the grant waits on its entry
expect_order: Player A puts Grizzly Bears to the battlefield
Grizzly Bears deals 2 damage to Player B
Grizzly Bears is moved to graveyard
